board.intro: The Executive Committee comprises nine members — five women and four men. Several are founder members of the organisation.

members.name: V. Vijaya Bhaskar
members.relation: S/o V. N. R. Subba Rayudu
members.bio: Having an experience of 33 years in the social service sector. One of the founder members of the organisation, having dedicated his life to the welfare of the poor and vulnerable. Holds a great concern for the life of Jogini and Basivini system victims, and is a staunch worker for the welfare of children — with specific reference to those affected and infected with chronic health issues.

members.name: K. Aruna Jyothi
members.bio: 68 years old, with an experience of 20 years in the social service sector. One of the founder members of the organisation. A person with a motherly heart, she is concerned above all with the plight of women and children in this area. She is an active speaker and a staunch supporter of girl child education.

members.name: P. Bhaskar Babu
members.bio: 61 years old, having dedicated his life to the welfare of farmers and farming communities, with 8 years of experience in the social service sector. Well educated and aware of the issues farmers face in this area, he is a staunch supporter of farming families, guiding them in modern methods of agriculture and allied fields.

members.name: T. Sailaja
members.bio: 43 years old, with an overall experience of 15 years in the social service sector. She has a good knowledge of rural communities, is well aware of rural problems, and has a great understanding of addressing those issues through community mobilisation.

members.name: G. Varalakshmi
members.bio: 62 years old, with an overall experience of 26 years in the social service sector. She has a good knowledge of the day-to-day issues faced by socially and economically disadvantaged families, with strong skills in communication and community management. She is a good trainer and counsellor in cases involving women and children, and in the economic empowerment of women.

members.name: A. Sirisha
members.bio: 33 years old, with an experience of about 5 years in the social service sector. Educated and focussed on youth and girl issues, she has played a great role in working out the social and psychological aspects among young people attending schools and other educational institutions. A good speaker, capable of dealing with the young about their problems.

members.name: N. Anil Kumar
members.bio: 43 years old, with 10 years of experience in the social service sector. Young and energetic, with focussed attention on youth, schooling, education and employment. A good speaker, skilled at convincing students and young people about their attitude, behaviour and their plans for the future.
